args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP despite the docstring (and the
nightly test suite) expecting banker's rounding per FIN-212. Switch to
ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP` (likely a copy/paste or naming slip, since the docstring already described banker's rounding).

## Change
- Switched `round_money` in `src/money.py` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Behavior
- `2.675` → `2.68`
- `2.665` → `2.66` (banker's rounding, ties go to even)

## Validation
- CI run on this branch: **passed** (run `ci-0001`, commit `08d3cd5986`)
